filer_side_mechanism.arithmetic: Published quarters sum to 33.10 − 62.50 + 32.30 + 86.68 = 89.58 lakh; the SAME document's audited FY23 total is 54.81 lakh. filer_side_mechanism.detres_is_faithful: Every one of those four printed figures equals detres to the last digit it carries: Mar-23 8.67 Rs-mn = 86.68 lakh, Dec-22 3.23 = 32.30, FY23 .50 5.48 = 54.81, FY22 .50 8.37 = 83.69. detres reproduces the filing; it is not the source of the residual.
filer_side_mechanism.consequence: §45's identity cannot arbitrate HALDER's pre-FY2026 quarters — it fails for a reason that lives in the filings. Those quarters therefore need the §58 route (the printed column in the company's own PDF), one document at a time. NOT attempted by this run; scoped as a follow-up below.
